notes.title: Tomo Endless Blue is a new anime RPG with elements of Minecraft and Palworld
notes.content:
There are so many brilliant anime-inspired RPGs out there these days, but few can claim to offer completely unique, procedurally generated worlds, Palworld-style creature collecting and battling, and block-based building like Minecraft all at the same time. That's exactly what Tomo Endless Blue is offering, and while it may initially seem rather cozy in its nature, it could be a lot darker than you might expect.
